```quiz
type: radio
id: EE01-M01-01-L03-q007
content: |-
  A signal equals $3t-1$ for $0\le t<2$ and equals $7-2t$ for $2\le t\le5$. Which piecewise definition represents $x(t)$?

options:
- id: a
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}3t-1, & 0\le t<2\\7-2t, & 2\le t\le5\end{cases}
    $$
  correct: true
  feedback: |-
    Each stated rule becomes one row of the piecewise definition. Keep the expression $3t-1$ paired with $0\le t<2$, and keep the expression $7-2t$ paired with $2\le t\le5$.

    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}3t-1, & 0\le t<2\\7-2t, & 2\le t\le5\end{cases}
    $$

- id: b
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}3t-1, & 0\le t\le2\\7-2t, & 2<t\le5\end{cases}
    $$

- id: c
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}7-2t, & 0\le t<2\\3t-1, & 2\le t\le5\end{cases}
    $$

- id: d
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}3t-1, & 0\le t<2\\7-2t, & 2<t\le5\end{cases}
    $$

- id: e
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}3t+1, & 0\le t<2\\7-2t, & 2\le t\le5\end{cases}
    $$
```

```quiz
type: radio
id: EE01-M01-01-L03-q008
content: |-
  A signal equals $-2$ for $-3\le t<-1$ and equals $t+4$ for $-1\le t\le2$. Which piecewise definition represents $x(t)$?

options:
- id: a
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}-2, & -3\le t<-1\\t+4, & -1\le t\le2\end{cases}
    $$
  correct: true
  feedback: |-
    The constant rule $-2$ stays attached to $-3\le t<-1$. The linear rule $t+4$ stays attached to $-1\le t\le2$. Place those two expression-and-condition pairs in brace form.

    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}-2, & -3\le t<-1\\t+4, & -1\le t\le2\end{cases}
    $$

- id: b
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}-2, & -3\le t\le-1\\t+4, & -1<t\le2\end{cases}
    $$

- id: c
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}t+4, & -3\le t<-1\\-2, & -1\le t\le2\end{cases}
    $$

- id: d
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}-2, & -3\le t<-1\\t-4, & -1\le t\le2\end{cases}
    $$

- id: e
  content: |-
    $$
    x(t)=\begin{cases}-2, & -3<t<-1\\t+4, & -1\le t<2\end{cases}
    $$
```
